## PageRequest interface

The paging inputs of a list operation, as SDK callers pass them.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface PageRequest
```

## Remarks

Both are optional. Without `cursor` the first page is read; without `pageSize` the page holds at most [PAGE_SIZE_LIMITS](./contracts.page_size_limits.md)<!-- -->.default items.
